ValidationRule.description: Opportunity credit is locked when opportunity is lock.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Opportunity_Credit_Bypass_Closed_Won_Lock ) , NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityValidations__c ) , ISPICKVAL( NSP_Opportunity__r.StageName , "Closed Won" ) , AND( ( $Profile.Name <> 'Data Migration' ) , ( $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User' ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once an Opportunity is Closed Won, the Opportunity Credits cannot be modified. Please contact Sales Operations team.
